title: THE EASY MODE AND INITIALS CARDS ARE SOLID DIALOGS AND PRESS A NAMES THE LOST PAD
why: The critic scored the in-raid easy mode card and the initials card 2 (see-through boxes; the initials card sat on the controls legend) and the press a screen 2 (a bare title over a pause menu). Both cards are now the guide dialog: solid panel fill, a lime tab, the question as the title, a primary yes and a ghost no with the live key or pad glyph, placed above the legend. The press a title says p1 or p2 pad lost, then p1 or p2 press a, in that player colour.
now: The easy mode and initials cards are solid dialog cards that stay clear of the controls list, and the lost pad screen names which pillager lost their pad.
